title: Community signup leaderboard and share link
requirements: After a successful waitlist signup, show a leaderboard of Ontario communities ranked by total signup counts.
Highlight the community the user selected and show its current rank and count.
Provide a share link (with referral/community attribution) and social share actions (e.g. X/Twitter, Facebook, WhatsApp, copy link) so users can invite others.
Aggregate counts server-side (Firestore aggregation or a scheduled/triggered Cloud Function) so the client never reads the full waitlist collection.
Expose a read-only public endpoint/collection for aggregate counts that does not leak individual signup data.
Handle empty/loading/error states and keep the leaderboard responsive on mobile.
Cover the leaderboard rendering and share-link generation with tests.
notes:
Implemented the community signup leaderboard and share links.

Server-side aggregation (functions/src/waitlist/aggregateCounts.ts):
- onWaitlistSignupCreated: Firestore onDocumentCreated trigger on waitlist/{signupId} that atomically increments waitlistCounts/{communityId}.count via FieldValue.increment with merge:true. Non-canonical community ids are logged and skipped.
- recomputeWaitlistCounts: HTTPS callable that recomputes every community count from scratch using Firestore count() aggregation queries (authoritative repair path). Requires auth (HttpsError unauthenticated otherwise). Writes zero counts for empty communities so the leaderboard renders a complete list.
- Both exported from functions/src/index.ts. COMMUNITY_IDS mirrors frontend/src/lib/ontario-communities.ts and is the stable aggregation key.

Public read-only aggregate surface (firestore.rules):
- waitlistCounts/{communityId}: allow read: if true; allow write: if false. Contains only { community, count, updatedAt } — no personal data. The waitlist collection remains create-only from the client, so individual signups are never enumerable.

Frontend data + share helpers (frontend/src/lib/leaderboard.ts, React-free for unit testing):
- fetchLeaderboard(): reads only waitlistCounts, tolerates missing/malformed docs (falls back to doc id / 0), returns ranked entries.
- rankCommunities(): sorts by count desc, ties broken alphabetically by label for deterministic ordering, assigns 1-based ranks, includes zero-count communities.
- findEntry(), buildShareUrl() (/waitlist?ref=<community>), buildShareText(), buildShareTargets() (X/Twitter, Facebook, WhatsApp with encoded url/text).

UI (frontend/src/components/marketing/CommunityLeaderboard.tsx + .module.css):
- Loading (role=status), error (role=alert with Try again), empty, and ready states.
- Highlights the joined community with a summary showing rank (#N) and count, and marks the matching list row with aria-current.
- Share section with social links (target=_blank, rel=noopener noreferrer) and a Copy link button using navigator.clipboard with a transient 'Link copied!' confirmation.
- Responsive: grid rows collapse on <=480px.

Wiring:
- WaitlistReferral now reveals the leaderboard inline after a successful/duplicate signup via WaitlistForm onSuccess.
- New route frontend/src/app/(marketing)/waitlist/leaderboard/page.tsx (metadata, robots index:false) with LeaderboardView client component reading ?community= (Suspense-wrapped for static export).

Tests (all passing):
- frontend/src/lib/leaderboard.test.ts: ranking, tie-break, zero-count inclusion, malformed-doc fallback, findEntry, share URL/text/targets.
- frontend/src/components/marketing/CommunityLeaderboard.test.tsx: loading, ranked rendering, highlight (rank/count/aria-current), share actions, clipboard copy, error+retry, empty state.

Verification: frontend typecheck, lint, 101 tests, and next build (static export incl. /waitlist/leaderboard) all pass. functions tsc build passes. Note: pre-existing scaffold lint style issues remain in functions/src/index.ts (4-space indent vs Google config) and were not introduced by this task; the unused `agent` var in the syncSearch stub was referenced with `void agent` so the functions package compiles.

REVISED WAITLIST WORKFLOW (per user feedback):
The "Join the waitlist" CTA now pipes directly into the registration workflow instead of a standalone public form:
1. User clicks "Join the waitlist" -> /register (LandingHero.tsx, (marketing)/page.tsx).
2. Firebase auth register page (frontend/src/app/(auth)/register/page.tsx). After sign-up the auth listener redirects signed-in users to /profile, carrying any ?ref= referral community through.
3. Basic profile form (frontend/src/app/(auth)/profile/page.tsx): first name, last name, email (pre-filled from auth), and community. Lives in the (auth) group so it is reachable while signed in but unverified. Skips ahead to the leaderboard when profileComplete is already true.
4. On save, redirects to /waitlist/leaderboard?community=<id> with the joined community highlighted.

Supporting changes:
- frontend/src/lib/auth.ts: UserProfile extended with firstName/lastName/community/profileComplete; added saveUserProfile() (writes profile + flips profileComplete, mirrors displayName onto the auth profile) and fetchUserProfile().
- frontend/src/lib/validation.ts: added validateFirstName/validateLastName/validateProfileForm.
- frontend/src/app/(marketing)/waitlist/page.tsx is now a legacy redirect into /register (preserving ?ref=) so existing share links keep working; WaitlistRedirect.tsx performs the client redirect.
- Register + profile pages read ?ref= via useSearchParams and are wrapped in Suspense boundaries for static export.

Tests: added profile page tests (7) and profile validation tests; updated register + landing page tests for the new redirect/CTA targets. Full suite: 116 frontend tests passing; typecheck, lint, next build (static export incl. /profile and /waitlist/leaderboard), and functions tsc build all pass.

--- Fix: region counters not updating (2026-10-14) ---
Symptom: a recent signup was not reflected in its region's count; no stats appeared in Firestore at all.

Root causes found and fixed:
1. Trigger region mismatch (why NOTHING was recorded): the Firestore database is in northamerica-northeast1 (firebase.json) but the 2nd-gen functions defaulted to us-central1. A 2nd-gen Firestore trigger is an Eventarc trigger that must be co-located with the database, so it never fired. Fixed by pinning the region explicitly per function in functions/src/waitlist/aggregateCounts.ts (REGION = 'northamerica-northeast1') and in setGlobalOptions in functions/src/index.ts. Note: setGlobalOptions alone was insufficient because ES module imports are evaluated before the importing module body, so aggregateCounts.ts registered its functions before setGlobalOptions ran.
2. Create-only trigger missed updates (why a region change was dropped): signup doc ids are derived deterministically from the email, so a returning user reuses the same document. onDocumentCreated only fires on first create, so community changes and deletes were never counted. Replaced with onDocumentWritten delta reconciliation: create => +1 new community; delete => -1 old community; update => -1 old and +1 new when community changed. waitlistCounts is now a pure function of the waitlist collection and self-heals.
3. Client write path was racy and never persisted a community change: submitWaitlistSignup used a non-transactional getDoc+setDoc and returned 'duplicate' without writing. Now uses runTransaction; a returning signup with a new community updates only the community field so the server can reconcile.
4. firestore.rules blocked the community update: waitlist/{signupId} allowed create only. Added a constrained update rule permitting only the 'community' field to change (diff().affectedKeys().hasOnly(['community'])); read/delete remain denied.
5. Tooling: added functions/.prettierrc.json (2-space, bracketSpacing:false, printWidth:80) so format-on-save stops fighting the ESLint 'google' config, which was blocking the functions predeploy lint gate.

Tests: frontend/src/lib/waitlist.test.ts updated to mock runTransaction and cover the create, duplicate-no-op, and community-change paths (19 tests passing across waitlist + leaderboard).
Deployed: firestore:rules and functions (all three functions now in northamerica-northeast1; stale us-central1 recomputeWaitlistCounts deleted).
Recovery: run recomputeWaitlistCounts (authenticated) once to backfill counts for signups created before the trigger was live.

Correction (2026-10-14): counter trigger moved to the users collection.
The intended behaviour is to aggregate from the `users` collection, not `waitlist`:
- onUserCommunityChanged: Firestore onDocumentWritten trigger on users/{userId}.
  * create: +1 to the community when it is non-empty.
  * update: if community is unchanged, no-op; if changed, -1 from the old
    community (when non-empty) and +1 to the new community (when non-empty).
  * delete: -1 from the old community when it was non-empty.
  * Empty values ("", null, or missing) are ignored entirely, so a user who
    has not picked a region never affects any counter. Non-canonical ids are
    logged and skipped.
- recomputeWaitlistCounts now counts from the `users` collection (where
  community == <id>) instead of `waitlist`.
- Exported from functions/src/index.ts as onUserCommunityChanged (replaces
  onWaitlistSignupCreated). The read-only waitlistCounts/{communityId}
  surface and the frontend leaderboard are unchanged.
